summary: The Shade Crucible is the origin point of War-Shade creation. Discord corruption binds fallen warriors into shadow-forged soldiers, overseen by Muramite ritualists and empowered by the Crucible’s dimensional instability.
history: The Crucible formed when Discord energy condensed into a ritual forge.
War-Shades were first created here from the shadows of fallen warriors.
Muramite overseers integrated Discord-forged machinery into the ritual process.
The Crucible Shade-Lord emerged as the master of War-Shade creation.
